description: Returns the status of a pending or completed deployment authorization request created by start_deployment, stop_deployment, update_deployment_revision, run_deployment_once, or place_trade. Use this after the user approves or denies the website authorization URL. Copy the actual actionId returned by the action tool; never guess an authorization request id. A deploymentId, botId or revisionId is not an actionId. If no action request has been created or returned, prepare the requested action first. Do not poll a known unapproved request merely to confirm that approval is still pending. For run_deployment_once, the authorization status describes approval and dispatch, not the strategy iteration. Pending approval means no strategy iteration has started. A completed action with metadata.executionResult.status=launched means launch accepted; completion and trades remain unverified. A skipped result started no new iteration. An already_recorded result is a duplicate dispatch; inspect its run_id, last_run_status and run history. A failed or unconfirmed dispatch without terminal run evidence leaves the iteration outcome unknown. Inspect run history before any new request; do not automatically retry or infer that the run failed or finished. A balance or holdings report does not verify iteration completion.  Answer questions about whether the RUN finished from iteration evidence: launched means completion is unverified. Do not lead with Yes and then qualify it when only the approval completed or launch was accepted.For Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other clients without BotSpot native confirmation cards, return the exact authorizationUrl as a clickable Markdown link in your reply. Do not say a card or button was created unless the client actually rendered it. BotSpot clients may render structuredContent as a native confirmation, but a button name alone is not an approval link. A pending request is not execution; only the signed-in user may approve on the website. Report expiry and check get_deployment_action_status after approval.
name: get_deployment_action_status
title: Check action authorization status
